title: Shared Plan
reference: F1 F1 F1 def DASH { F1 F1 } def F1 { forward turn_right forward turn_left }
hints: F1 belongs to the whole squad. Both bots can call it.
F1: forward, turn right, forward, turn left. LoopBot calls it three times, DASH twice.
F1 F1 F1 def DASH { F1 F1 } def F1 { forward turn_right forward turn_left }

story.intro: LEDGER: "Captain LEDGER. In my briefing room, a plan is written once and followed by everyone. That is what F1 is for. Both of you may call it."
story.outro: DASH: "The captain spoke to us! LEDGER never speaks to anyone! I think that was a smile. It was one pixel. But it was there."
